title: Transfer of coefficient equations to every positive-degree Proj chart
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L$ invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], $S$ its section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring], $d>0$, $s\in S_d$, and $U$ open with $s|_U$ a free generator [def-sc-local-free-generator]. Let $\rho:S_{(s)}\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ring map satisfying $\rho(\xi/s^n)s^n|_U=\xi|_U$ for every $n$ and $\xi\in S_{nd}$. Let $q:U\to\operatorname{Spec}S_{(s)}$ induce $\rho$ on global sections under the canonical spectrum and open-subscheme section identifications [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme]. Set $g=q\circ\iota_s:U\to\operatorname{Proj}S$ [def-pc-proj]. For every $e>0$, $t\in S_e$, $n\geq0$, and $\xi\in S_{ne}$, on the ambient image $W\subseteq X$ of $g^{-1}D_+(t)$ one has $g^\sharp(\xi/t^n)(t^n)|_W=\xi|_W$. This theorem verifies a given affine map; it asserts no existence of $q$ or $\rho$.

source.place: Tags 01N8 (local quotient construction and comparison) and 01NK (different positive degrees)

proof.text: Apply the second-chart generator theorem to show that the restriction of t is a free generator on W. Induct on k=n(d-1): exponent zero is the tensor-unit section, and the successor step is the tensor product of the preceding generator with t, transported through tensorPowAddIso. DirectSum.of_mul_of verifies that these generators are exactly the components of the section-ring powers t^k.

source.place: Tags 01N8 (local quotient construction and comparison) and 01NK (different positive degrees)

proof.text: Apply the cross-multiplication theorem. Extract the single-component representatives of ξ and t^k; DirectSum.of_mul_of and evaluation in degree ne+ke identify its right side with tensorPowAddIso.inv applied to ξ|W tensor t^k|W. Naturality moves restriction inside tensor multiplication. Linearity moves the pullback scalar inside the same isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 01N8 (local quotient construction and comparison) and 01NK (different positive degrees)

proof.text: The tensorPowAddIso map is bijective on sections, so cancel it. Tensoring on the right with the free generator t^k|W is injective by WeilConjectures IsFreeGenerator.injective_tmulSection_right. Cancel that factor and obtain the required quotient equation. This uses no additional geometric hypothesis and includes k=0, n=0 and the empty W.
